name: readme-layered-libraries
body:
README layered libraries: README.md explains the deck's template library as one merged set drawn from up to two layers — the external library named by the `templates:` key and the deck-root `templates/` directory, both loaded when both are present, with equal standing and no precedence. It states: the layers merge with no precedence; a name carried by both layers (a slide or section name, a theme name, or a shared `media/` path) is a validation error naming the name and both paths, never an override (library-layer-uniqueness); a reference written in a template or theme resolves within that template's or theme's own layer while a local template's `section` helper call resolves across the merged set (library-layer-references); the external layer is self-contained and validates standalone; and changing the configured `templates:` value while `kalide start` runs requires a restart (template-retarget-requires-restart). README.md links to docs/layered-libraries.md for the how-to (docs-layered-libraries).

AC: README.md states the two layers merge with no precedence; a name in both layers is an error naming the name and both paths; own-layer references plus the cross-layer `section` call; external standalone validation; and retarget-needs-restart; it links to docs/layered-libraries.md.
